subject: Pilot migration runway and customer notice - proposed MAP
messages:
From: Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Platform Team <platform@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood model migration for pilot - timeline and impact questions

Hi Camila,

Appreciate the demo last week. Our pilot (internal knowledge assistant) is on v1 of your chat endpoint; we heard there's a planned model family consolidation in Q3. Before we schedule internal stakeholders, can you share:

- Target sunset date for the v1 endpoint (if set)
- Expected API surface changes (param names, response shape)
- Any known behavior diffs that could affect our prompt templates

We have a compliance window in late Aug and need to confirm whether we have to freeze changes. If helpful, happy to run a smoke test during the pilot.

Thanks,
Lydia

--
Lydia Ramos
Product Lead, Search & Assist
Acme Corp

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood model migration for pilot - timeline and impact questions

Hi Lydia — thanks for the note and for joining the demo. Short answers first:

- We are targeting a phased consolidation starting 2027-09-20 with customer cutovers between 2027-09-20 and 2027-11-01.
- There will be lightweight API parameter stabilizations (no breaking renames planned) and a single unified response envelope for chat/structured output.
- We do expect small behavior deltas (tokenization/temperature defaults + improved prompt conditioning) that can change edge-case outputs; we surface these as a compatibility report.

I'd like to propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can lock dates and a smoke test window that won't block your compliance freeze. I cc'd Ben (infra/ops owner) and Marissa (product comms) to scope the plan and share a compatibility artifact. Attached: a draft MAP and a pilot compatibility summary.

Proposed next steps (high level):
1) Redwood provides pilot compatibility report and suggested prompt adjustments — target by 2027-07-23
2) Joint smoke test (ACME staging) — 2027-08-05 to 2027-08-08
3) Freeze window confirmation by Acme legal/ops — 2027-08-20
4) Cutover scheduling: flexible within the Sept–Oct runway, we accommodate a single-day cutover and rollback window.

Are these milestones workable from your side? If so, we'll formalize the MAP and include runbook contacts and a rollback hatch.

Thanks,
Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx, pilot-compatibility-summary.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood model migration for pilot - timeline and impact questions

Adding a bit of technical color from infra:

- The consolidation is primarily model-family consolidation + an opt-in compatibility shim. For most customers we'll offer a compatibility flag for 60 days post-cutover that preserves tokenization defaults and prior soft-prompts.
- We will provide a small test harness (curl + sample payloads) and a staged endpoint: staging.redwood.ai/acme/compat for you to run smoke tests.
- Known diffs: a) slightly stricter JSON schema for function/tool calling (we'll provide lint rules), b) trimming of trailing whitespace in assistant messages which can affect fuzzy-match prompts.

Operational asks for Acme: please confirm a staging contact and an SSH window if you want us to run a supervised smoke test from our side.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lydia Ramos <lydia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood model migration for pilot - timeline and impact questions

Thanks team — a couple comms/contract notes:

- For customers in a pilot/paid pilot, we typically send a 30-day pre-cutover notice plus a tailored runbook. Given Acme's compliance freeze, let's push the pre-cutover notice to 35 days and include explicit rollback SLAs.
- Pricing: no change for pilot customers during the consolidation; any long-term pricing changes would be communicated separately with 60 days' notice.
- Legal will require an addendum only if Acme requests a guaranteed freeze/lock on behavior for a specific window. If they need that, loop Legal early.

Camila — can you confirm whether Acme requires a signed DocuSign addendum for the freeze? If yes, I'll engage Contracts.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Redwood model migration for pilot - timeline and impact questions

Lydia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Acme's proposed timeline works with one ask: if you need a hard behavior freeze for the compliance window, let us know by 2027-07-26 so Legal can prepare an addendum and we can route DocuSign.

Practical next steps from our side:
- We'll finalize the MAP (attached v1) and share the staged endpoint + test vectors by 2027-07-23.
- Ben will coordinate a supervised run (if you grant an SSH window) during the Aug 5–8 smoke test window.
- Marissa will prepare a 35-day pre-cutover notice and a rollback SLA to include in the addendum (if requested).

If that aligns, I'll update the MAP and send to your legal/ops contact.

Best,
Camila
